thread:
Anna Chen: Heads-up: we need a quick go/no-go on the audit event schema bump. Plan: add actor.source (object), rename client_id -> client_meta, and deprecate origin. Can we align on versioning and migration window? 20m sync?

Marco Li: +1. I think we should put an explicit numeric event_version in the envelope (event_version: 3) and run a compatibility shim at the edge translating v2 -> v3. Keep both advertised for two weeks.

Sarah Patel: KMS note: actor.id is currently hashed and key-wrapped under key-A. actor.source will include free-text (sdk/service). Treating that as sensitive seems prudent. Suggest we encrypt actor.source with same wrapping policy and only unwrap for audit_read principals.

Phil Gomez: RBAC enforcement required. Ensure non-audit roles never receive actor.source plaintext. Enforcement points: audit read API, internal consumer adapter, and the console download endpoint. Add integration deny tests.

Isabella Ortiz: Customer-facing validation: publish sample v2->v3 payloads and a lightweight validator script. Console should provide a preview/one-click converter so customers can test before we flip flags.

Marco Li: v3 envelope sketch:
```
{
  "event_version": 3,
  "ts": "2025-11-06T09:14:00Z",
  "actor": { "id": "sha256:abcd...", "source": { "type": "sdk", "name": "node-client", "ver": "1.4.0" } },
  "client_meta": { "id": "cm-54", "platform": "android" },
  "action": "model.generate",
  "meta": { "seq": 123 }
}
```
Use namespaced source.type.

Anna Chen: Who still relies on the old origin string? We need a fallback plan before drop.

Phil Gomez: Quick grep shows a few adapters and an export job that reference origin. Plan: add shim origin->client_meta.platform for two releases, email owners, and add linter warnings. I'll enumerate and open PRs.

Sarah Patel: Security triage: researcher found unbounded actor.source.name causing our log parser to spin and crash in a rare path (tokenizer exhaustion). RCE potential low but unacceptable. Cap actor.source.name at 256 bytes, reject longer values at ingestion, and log SEC-2025-104.

Isabella Ortiz: For customers we'll offer a webhook endpoint where they POST samples and get a pass/fail with a remediation diff. Draft deprecation notice: 30/60/90 day cadence with console banners.

deploy-bot: deploy attempt in staging reported: audit-schema-migration tests 18/118 failing  majority are RBAC deny tests and KMS unwrap timeouts.

Marco Li: Acknowledge. Stage KMS key is rate-limited; I'll add retries/backoff for unwrap and a small circuit-breaker. Also gate the shim with a feature flag to allow quick rollback.

Anna Chen: Action items:
- Marco: KMS timeout mitigation + feature flag wiring (EOD)
- Phil: full list of adapters touching origin + shims + migration PRs (48h)
- Sarah: implement ingestion length cap, update SEC ticket (ASAP)
- Isabella: validator webhook + customer deprecation copy (3 business days)
- Ops: canary rollout EU-west first, reserve replay capacity.

Phil Gomez: I'll update the internal audit lib to strip actor.source for callers without audit_read. Adding unit/integration deny tests.

Marco Li: We should set schema_version in Kafka headers (schema_version: 3) for router/consumer fast-path and keep event_version in the envelope for consumer verification. Headers make routing simple.

Sarah Patel: I'll draft a rollback runbook: how to toggle the shim feature-flag, how to reconstruct origin from client_meta temporarily, and how to rehydrate downstream indices if needed.

ops-runner: I've reserved Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC for a migration window and can provision replay workers if we need to backfill.

Isabella Ortiz: I'll prepare console preview and email copy. Will attach conversion examples for common SDKs.

Anna Chen: Also log admin actions when feature flags or replays are executed (admin-audit) so we can trace who ran the migration.

Marco Li: Suggest adding a small partition-harness test that runs v2->v3 translation against a sample of Kafka partitions before a full flip.

Phil Gomez: Add an integration assertion that origin==client_meta.platform when shimmed so we don't silently diverge.

Anna Chen: Great progress. Reconvene after KMS retries pass in staging. :thumbsup:
